bio:
Jiwon Baeq is a director of photography working in commercial, branded, and music video production. Her work favors natural light, restrained camera movement, and a color palette that stays true to the world in front of the lens.

She has shot for brands including American Airlines, Bose, REI, Mars, and Manscaped, and collaborates closely with directors and agencies from prep through final grade. She is available for projects worldwide.
